source_text: Adult female non-blood fed mosquitoes, two to five days old, were exposed to 0.05% deltamethrin for one hour, using WHO tubes and criteria... A total of 291 mosquitoes were tested with deltamethrin in Tiassalé (n=200)... Mortality rates were 25% in Tiassalé
A total of 291 mosquitoes were tested with deltamethrin in Tiassalé (n=200) and Elibou (n=91) during the rainy season... Mortality rates were 25% in Tiassalé and 4.4% in Elibou.
